title: The Sodder Children Fire
hook: On Christmas Eve 1945, a blaze swallowed the Sodder home, yet five children vanished.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On December 24, 1945, a fire engulfed the Sodder home in Fairview, West Virginia.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Five of the ten Sodder children were never found, despite a massive search.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Neighbors reported hearing no screams and seeing the fire start from the roof.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: Investigators found the family's car missing and a ladder placed against the house.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: One theory suggests the children escaped through a hidden tunnel beneath the cellar.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: In 2021, a new witness claimed a stranger was seen buying gasoline near the Sodders before the fire.

end.line: Could the missing children still be alive somewhere?

description: A baffling 1945 house fire left five Sodder children vanished without a trace.

facts.claim: The fire occurred on December 24, 1945, in Fairview, West Virginia
Five of the ten Sodder children were never found
Neighbors reported hearing no screams during the blaze
The family's car was missing and a ladder was found against the house
A hidden tunnel theory was proposed by the Sodder family
In 2021 a witness claimed a stranger bought gasoline before the fire
